---
title: "👑 National Placers (1st–8th)"
subtitle: "Explore national champions and All-American podium finishers across all weight classes (2019–2026)."
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

source("_setup.R")

reactable(
  placers_df |> select(place, wrestler, school, weight_class, year, record, medal_bout),
  theme = tbl_theme,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 15,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 15, 25, 50, 80),
  rowStyle = \(index) {
    if (placers_df$place_num[index] == 1) {
      list(background = "#fffbeb", fontWeight = "600")
    }
  },
  columns = list(
    place = colDef(name = "Podium Finish", minWidth = 140, cell = badge_place),
    wrestler = colDef(
      name = "Wrestler",
      minWidth = 160,
      cell = \(value, index) {
        if (placers_df$place_num[index] == 1) {
          tags$span(style = "font-weight: 750; color: #0f172a;", paste0("⭐ ", value))
        } else {
          tags$span(value)
        }
      }
    ),
    school = colDef(name = "Collegiate Team", minWidth = 180),
    weight_class = colDef(name = "Weight", width = 95, align = "center", format = colFormat(suffix = " lbs")),
    year = colDef(name = "Year", width = 80, align = "center"),
    record = colDef(name = "Tourney Record", width = 125, align = "center"),
    medal_bout = colDef(name = "Medal Round Outcome", minWidth = 240)
  )
)
```
